place.prompt: A forest clearing ringed by huge trees and standing stones, painted as an anime background.

shots.name: the thief
shots.title: the thief
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. Wide and low, from behind the young woman with long wavy sea-green hair, a red dress and red boots as she walks up the path into a clearing ringed by old standing stones and stops. Across the clearing, in front of a great mossy boulder, the lanky harlequin jester in a purple-and-yellow diamond costume and two-horned cap stands waiting, lazily swinging a small stone pendant glowing like a live coal on a thin gold chain back and forth, its glow flickering. Leaves drift down through shafts of late sunlight. The camera pushes in slowly. The clearing, the trees, the standing stones and the light stay exactly as they are. Sound: wind in the trees, her footsteps on dry leaves, the faint tinkle of a chain, a soft giggle. No music.
shots.avoid_extra: 3d render, cgi, photorealistic, live action, a crowd, other people, blood, gore
shots.note: She arrives; he is waiting for her with something that glows. Cuts to her face (020). (shot 1 of 20, before 020)
